No. 3 of 2025
AN ACT to amend the Child Justice Act, Cap. 3.09.
[ 17th March, 2025 ]
BE IT ENACTED by the King’s Most Excellent Majesty, by
and with the advice and consent of the House of Assembly and the
Senate of Saint Lucia, and by the authority of the same as follows:

12
No. 3 ] Child Justice (Amendment) Act [ 2025
Short title
1. This Act may be cited as the Child Justice (Amendment)
Act, 2025.
Interpretation
2. In this Act, “principal Act” means the Child Justice Act,
Cap. 3.09
Amendment of section 54
3. Section 54(2) of the principal Act is amended by deleting the
words “that sentence shall be for a period not exceeding three years”
and substituting the words “, the Court may impose a sentence it
deems appropriate”.
Amendment of section 81
4. Section 81(3) of the principal Act is amended by deleting the
words “Section 27”and substituting the words “Section 26”.
Passed in the House of Assembly this 25th day of February,
2025.
CLAUDIUS J. FRANCIS,
Speaker of the House of Assembly.
Passed in the Senate this 27th day of February, 2025.
ALVINA REYNOLDS,
President of the Senate.
